dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef001 n is the type of n by n real matrices, represented as functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies that the universally quantified A and B are square real matrices of dimension n.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef002 A B is the conjunction X Y = I, Y X = I, and Y(0,2) = AB, where X is LocalDef006 A B, Y is LocalDef007 A B, I is LocalDef008 n, and the products use LocalDef009.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the complete conclusion asserted for every admissible n, A, and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a proof that the natural number 2 + 1, hence 3, is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports interpreting numeral indices as elements of Fin 3; it adds no hypothesis or separate mathematical conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef004 n is the type of 3 by 3 block matrices whose blocks are n by n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the ambient type of X, Y, their products, and the block identity matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef005 n A B is the ordinary matrix product AB, with (AB)(i,j) = sum over k in Fin n of A(i,k) B(k,j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the upper-right block of Y and the exact matrix appearing on the right side of Y(0,2) = AB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef006 A B is the 3 by 3 block matrix X = [[I_n, A, 0_n], [0_n, I_n, B], [0_n, 0_n, I_n]].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the first block matrix in both asserted inverse identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef007 A B is the 3 by 3 block matrix Y = [[I_n, -A, AB], [0_n, I_n, -B], [0_n, 0_n, I_n]].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the claimed two-sided inverse of X and makes its block at row 0, column 2 exactly AB.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef008 n is the identity element of the 3 by 3 block-matrix type: I_n on the block diagonal and 0_n off the diagonal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the right side of both exact block-matrix product equalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef009 X Y is ordinary 3 by 3 block-matrix multiplication, with each output block equal to the sum of three ordered products of n by n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the products X Y and Y X in the two inverse claims.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: LT.lt selects the strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the natural-number LT instance, it makes the hypothesis hn mean 0 < n.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nat is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the dimension n and of the numeral used in the positivity hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: OfNat.ofNat interprets a natural-number numeral in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the numeral 0 in the hypothesis and the numeral entries and indices occurring in the block constructions.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: instLTNat equips natural numbers with their usual strict order Nat.lt.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the target assumption is the ordinary inequality 0 < n.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: instOfNatNat interprets each natural numeral as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the target's numeral 0 the ordinary natural number zero.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: And is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the three conclusions as X Y = I and, simultaneously, Y X = I and Y(0,2) = AB.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Eq is exact propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All three conclusions are exact equalities, not approximations or inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fin n indexes rows and columns of A and B, while Fin 3 indexes rows and columns of the block matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.instOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: For nonzero n, Fin.instOfNat interprets a numeral i as Fin.ofNat n i, namely its canonical residue modulo n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin 3 it interprets the displayed indices 0 and 2 as the first and third block positions.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix m n alpha is definitionally the function type m -> n -> alpha, with the first argument serving as row index and the second as column index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the entrywise meaning of all real matrices and block matrices and of the access Y(0,2).

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the scalar field of A, B, and every n by n block to be the real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: DFunLike.coe applies an object equipped with a dependent function-like coercion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is coercion machinery used to apply Matrix.of and does not alter the entries of the explicitly constructed matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Equiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equiv alpha beta is the type of equivalences between alpha and beta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type in which Matrix.of packages the definitional equivalence between matrix-valued functions and matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Equiv.instEquivLike

dependency_coverage.name: EquivLike.toFunLike

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin.fintype n gives the finite enumeration of Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: HAdd.hAdd selects the heterogeneous addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it evaluates the natural-number expression 2 + 1 used in the nonzero proof for the size 3.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: HMul.hMul selects the multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It invokes ordinary matrix multiplication for AB and ordinary block-matrix multiplication for X Y and Y X.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.addCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.addCommMonoid gives matrices pointwise zero and pointwise commutative addition whenever their entries form an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the addition and zero operations needed to sum products in real matrix multiplication and block-matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This instance defines matrix multiplication by (MN)(i,k) = sum over j of M(i,j) N(j,k).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes both AB and the two block products as standard ordered matrix products.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instMulOfFintypeOfAddCommMonoid

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows n by n matrices to serve as the multiplicative entries of the 3 by 3 block matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.neg defines matrix negation pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes -A and -B in Y the entrywise additive negatives of A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.of
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.of is the identity equivalence between a two-argument function and the corresponding matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It packages the nested row vectors as X and Y without transposition or any change of entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.one defines the identity matrix, with scalar one on the diagonal and scalar zero off the diagonal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies I_n for the diagonal blocks and the 3 by 3 block identity used in the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.vecCons
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.vecCons prepends a head entry to a finite vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Repeated uses explicitly assemble the three rows and three columns of X and Y in the displayed order.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.vecEmpty
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.vecEmpty is the unique vector indexed by Fin 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It terminates the explicit finite-vector constructions of the block-matrix rows and row list.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix.zero defines a matrix whose every entry is scalar zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the zero n by n blocks in X and Y and the off-diagonal blocks of the identity.

dependency_coverage.name: NeZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: NeZero x is the proposition that x is not equal to zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to 2 + 1, it enables numeral indexing in Fin 3 and imposes no condition on A, B, or n.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Neg.neg selects the unary negation operation supplied by a Neg instance.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This instance supplies the real number 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This instance supplies the real number 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.ofOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Zero.ofOfNat0 constructs a distinguished zero operation from an interpretation of the numeral 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is instance plumbing for zero-valued matrix entries and introduces no additional proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes every displayed block-valued 0 denote the zero n by n matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: instAddNat gives natural numbers their usual addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the auxiliary dimension expression 2 + 1 equal to 3.

binders: Two arbitrary matrices A and B in M_n(R), with rows and columns indexed by Fin n.
hypotheses: There are no algebraic hypotheses on A or B; in particular, neither matrix is assumed invertible or commuting with the other.
conclusions: For X = [[I_n, A, 0_n], [0_n, I_n, B], [0_n, 0_n, I_n]] and Y = [[I_n, -A, AB], [0_n, I_n, -B], [0_n, 0_n, I_n]], the exact block-matrix equality X Y = I_{3,n} holds.
The exact block-matrix equality Y X = I_{3,n} also holds.
The block of Y at zero-based row 0 and column 2 is exactly the ordinary matrix product AB.
mathematical_definitions: M_n(R) denotes the n by n real matrices.
For A,B in M_n(R), (AB)(i,j) = sum over k in Fin n of A(i,k) B(k,j).
I_n is the n by n identity matrix and 0_n is the n by n zero matrix.
I_{3,n} is the 3 by 3 block identity with I_n on its block diagonal and 0_n elsewhere.
Multiplication of the 3 by 3 block matrices is standard matrix multiplication, preserving the order of block products.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive natural number n and every pair of n by n real matrices A and B, the upper unitriangular block matrix with A in block position (0,1) and B in block position (1,2) has the explicit two-sided inverse whose corresponding blocks are -A, -B, and AB. More precisely, X Y and Y X both equal the 3 by 3 block identity, and the (0,2) block of the displayed inverse Y is exactly AB.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The quantifier requires 0 < n, so the declaration makes no nonvacuous assertion at n = 0, even though the displayed identities can still be interpreted for zero-dimensional matrices.
All equalities are exact equalities over real matrices; no norm, tolerance, approximation, floating-point operation, rounding error, conditioning statement, or stability bound is encoded.
The final equality Y(0,2) = AB follows directly from the definition of Y and is therefore a definitional restatement of its upper-right block.
No existential witnesses occur: the inverse candidate Y is explicitly defined from A and B.
The proposition does not separately assert determinant formulas, uniqueness of the inverse, or invertibility of A or B.
Block indices are zero-based elements of Fin 3, so position (0,2) means the first block row and third block column.
